title: IFRA President delivers keynote at CAFFCI Annual Meeting and Expo in Nanjing
summary: Alexander Mohr addressed the high-level fragrance and flavor forum on the global trends reshaping the industry and the growing weight of the Asia Pacific market.

extraction.key_fact: 국제향료협회 회장이 난징에서 열린 연례 총회에 참석하여 산업 트렌드와 아시아 태평양 시장의 중요성에 대해 연설했다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: Alexander Mohr addressed the high-level fragrance and flavor forum on the global trends reshaping the industry and the growing weight of the Asia Pacific market.
